summary: perf(settings): load Settings, CAD and DTM Glean events lazily
description:
Because:

- Every route bundled the 13 Settings, CAD and DTM Glean metric modules.

This commit:

- Moves their 93 recordEventMetric cases to lib/glean/lazy-events.ts.
- Loads lazy-events with a dynamic import in the glean-lazy-events chunk.
- Awaits recordEventMetric in the queued lambda to keep the call order.
- Adds a table test for the moved events and a call order test.

Closes FXA-14859
